reasons: Both answers flag the notarial requirement, say the unnotarized deal is void, say the notary files Р13014, and handle the money already paid. A misstates п. 12 ст. 21: since 2016 the share passes when the ЕГРЮЛ entry is made, not when the deal is notarized. That error drives A's advice on the month-end deadline, telling the user the share will pass in September. B gets the transfer moment right, so its deadline assessment is realistic, and it adds useful points about the participants list and the pre-emptive right.

A: Claims the share passes to the buyer when the deal is notarized (п. 12 ст. 21); under the current law it passes when the ЕГРЮЛ entry is made, so the claim that the share will pass in September is wrong
Gives the notarial tariff as 0.5% with a 1,500 minimum and a 20,000 cap under the Tax Code; for share sales the usual cap is 150,000 (the ~5,000 estimate is still roughly correct)
B: Cites ст. 333.24 НК РФ for the 1,500–150,000 tariff range; those limits come from ст. 22.1 of the Fundamentals of Notary Law (Основы о нотариате), a minor citation slip
